summary: A classic everyone can play: most players find all ten, and the tension comes from Russian, Japanese and German just missing out.
reasons: Every answer is familiar; Bengali, Urdu and Indonesian are the 'oh right' picks. The casual player found 10/10 but with one life left.
Fair near misses: Russian #11, German #12, Japanese #13. 'chinese', 'arabic' and 'bangla' all match.
The top 10 is clean; the problems are in the wider pool and missing aliases.
fixes: 'german' offers 'German-Russian macaronic language' next to Standard German, and 'punjabi' offers 'Punjabi dialects'; drop those pool entries so the guesses go straight to the ranked answer.

'farsi' costs a life as the unranked 'Hijra Farsi' instead of matching Iranian Persian (#27): add alias 'Farsi'. Also add 'Cantonese' to Yue Chinese (#25), 'Filipino' to Tagalog (#23) and 'Shanghainese' to Wu Chinese (#26); these are not recognized now.

The universe pool has non-language titles: 'Classical languages of India', 'Indian states by most spoken scheduled languages', 'Languages of India', 'Multilingualism in India', 'Aimol people'. Filter them out.
